defaults.identityEvidence: Require the named food and all named variety/origin qualifiers for a specific identity. A generic identity may accept a named same-form member, without assigning that member to the user.
defaults.forms: Unprepared raw produce only. Reject cooked, canned, frozen, dried, pickled, sauced, stuffed, chips, juice, soup, salsa, blends and other prepared products; bare group labels/brand-only/ambiguous food titles remain unverified.
defaults.mixedOffers: Reject composite food products and unresolved either/or or multi-food titles for a precise identity. Do not transfer a mixed group quote to a single member. Brand cleaning must retain the food noun.
defaults.prices: No new fixed prices. Do not infer edible yield from bag weight, dehusking, peeling, seeding or USDA portions. Preserve observed price unit and uncertainty; per-store titles and costs stay attached to the actual offer.
defaults.history: Retain market IDs and historical prices unchanged. Counterpart records are distinct from recipe-use records.

ambiguousTerms.decision: Accept only generic potatoes unless Yukon Gold is explicitly stated. Do not alias gold to the cultivar.

Do not alias to poblano. Fresh/dried identity is unresolved by this keyword; reject for these fresh counterparts without explicit reviewed food evidence. Dried pasilla is outside this fresh market association.
Require an explicitly named fresh Hatch green chile food, not a brand alone; do not infer mild heat or substitute into bulk poblano slots.

decisions.rationale: Market association identifies a supported possible food only. It establishes neither inventory ownership, sibling identity, fixed price, USDA equivalence nor recipe compatibility. Each original observed offer and store needs independent title/form qualification.
